memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “There is a time to laugh and a time to weep.” — Ecclesiastes 3:4

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Laughter and fun are good gifts given by God. He created us with the ability to enjoy, rejoice, and find relief through healthy joy. God is not against laughter; He delights in wholesome joy and healthy fun.
However, when fun becomes excessive, it can slowly drain our spiritual sensitivity and weaken God’s power working within us. Especially during seasons of spiritual responsibility—prayer, ministry, preparation, or divine assignments—uncontrolled laughter and improper joking can cause us to lose the anointing we have carefully built through prayer.
Satan understands this very well. Just before moments when God’s power is most needed, he tries to distract us through excessive laughter, careless talk, or unhealthy fun, so that our spiritual preparedness is lost. The glorious presence and power of the Holy Spirit gained through hours of prayer can sometimes be lost in just a few minutes of careless words or inappropriate fun.
Therefore, laughter must have a time, a place, and a measure.
Fun that preserves holiness becomes a blessing; fun without restraint becomes a loss.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “Spiritual sensitivity can be lost in a moment, but it takes time to recover it.” — A. W. Tozer

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, Help us to enjoy joy without losing holiness.
Give us wisdom to guard our spiritual sensitivity and anointing. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Do not let fun control you—learn to control fun for God’s glory.  May the Lord guard your thoughts, words, and conduct, and keep you abiding in His anointing and power.
